classification.difficultyReason: Use the known midpoint and one endpoint to find the other endpoint.

content.prompt:
The point $(9,5)$ is the midpoint of the interval $PQ$, where $P$ has coordinates $(5,3)$.
What are the coordinates of $Q$?

spec.description: Unticked coordinate axes with rightward and upward arrowheads. An ascending segment contains filled points P, R and Q in that order. P and R have supplied coordinate labels; Q has its name only. NOT TO SCALE appears to the right on two lines.
spec.mathematics: R(9,5) is the midpoint of PQ and P=(5,3). R lies halfway along the segment. No coordinate range or tick scale is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Show P(5,3), R(9,5) and Q; do not show Q's coordinates.
